title: Article: Why Doesn’t God Save Us? The Hidden Truth About Masters & “Astral Bodies”- Asha Pathshala

segments.text: If God exists, why do sincere spiritual seekers still face struggles and attacks while walking on the spiritual path?

We often hear—and even witness—that many people suffer even though God exists. Sometimes we also see that individuals performing spiritual practices like homa, mantra chanting, or other rituals face difficulties or even spiritual attacks. History also tells us similar stories. This naturally raises an important question: If God is there, why doesn’t He always protect spiritual people from suffering?

Have you ever thought about this? Why do people who walk on a spiritual path often seem to struggle more? Why are genuine practitioners of spirituality rarely famous or widely known, while people who simply sing mythological songs often gain much more recognition? There are many saints who are sincere and deeply spiritual, yet they remain unknown to the world—why does this happen?
Independence or Guidance — What Is the Real Path?
Is meditation about becoming powerful on your own, or is true growth possible only with guidance and surrender?

Another question that often arises is about meditation and other spiritual practices . Some people believe that meditation is superior because in meditation a person works on themselves and strengthens their own inner power. In contrast, practices like mantra chanting are often seen as acts of surrender, where a person offers themselves to the divine rather than focusing on personal empowerment.

If we look at Western civilization , the emphasis is often on self-development and individual power. Meditation is promoted as a way to strengthen the individual so that a person becomes independent and self-reliant. Indian spiritual culture , however, takes a slightly different approach. It teaches that independence can come—but usually after learning how to depend on the right guidance first .

In many Western teachings, the message is: “You are your own master.” Whereas in Indian tradition the idea is more like: “You can become the master of yourself—but you still need someone who can guide you on the path.”

Both cultures acknowledge the existence of the astral or subtle world , but the way they approach it can be different. In India, the tradition often involves aligning with a higher authority—such as a guru or spiritual guide. A seeker places themselves under that guidance and walks the path with devotion.

Even in normal life, this pattern can be seen in society where many people work under someone who leads them. Sometimes this system works very well, and sometimes it doesn’t. Ultimately, whether it becomes beneficial or harmful depends largely on the strength and integrity of the master being followed .
If the master is strong and genuine, the person under that guidance can also become strong. But if the master is weak or misguided, the follower may struggle as well.
Who Is Really Guiding Your Destiny?

Now let’s try to understand this from an astral perspective . Throughout history, strong spiritual masters have established Guru Paramparas (spiritual lineages) . A powerful master doesn’t just guide one person; over time, their influence spreads and many people begin to follow that lineage.

Astrally, there is always a subtle force connected with us, often referred to as the subtle body . In many ways, we become dependent on this subtle body for guidance because it operates at a level that understands more than our ordinary mind. However, an important question arises here: who is guiding that subtle body?

The energy or force guiding your subtle body plays a major role in shaping your destiny. If that guidance comes from a negative influence , then the direction of your life may also move toward negativity. But if a divine energy or higher master is guiding it, then your destiny naturally begins to align with that higher energy.

To understand this better, we can take the example of Bhaiya . Whenever something unfavorable is about to happen to him, his master becomes aware of it and informs him beforehand. The master may not interfere directly in every situation, but he keeps Bhaiya aware and alert about what is coming .

This is one of the key responsibilities of a true master —to guide and warn their disciple about situations that may affect their life. If a master is unable to provide this guidance or awareness, then it becomes important for a seeker to reconsider whether they are under the right guidance.

A person who does not understand when and why it may be necessary to change their master or guidance can end up struggling for a long time. Without the right direction, life can gradually become difficult and confusing.
Why a Powerful Master Matters
The unseen guidance that can protect and direct your life.
Everyone has a master — whether they believe in God or not. A master is the subtle guiding energy that influences a person’s life and decisions.

When someone has a strong master and a deep connection with that master , they can receive guidance that helps them avoid misfortune. For example, if a natural disaster like an earthquake is about to happen, a person with strong spiritual guidance may feel an inner warning beforehand. This intuitive signal can help them move away and protect themselves.

However, sometimes spiritual people still face attacks or even death while performing practices like bhajans, havans, or other spiritual rituals . In many cases, it is not because their master did not guide them. The guidance may have been given, but the person may have chosen to stay and accept that destiny instead of leaving.
So the master’s role is to guide , but the final choice always belongs to the individual.
Note: Everyone has a master guiding them in some form, whether they realize it or not.
The Hidden Truth Behind the 33 Crore Deities
You may have often heard that there are 33 crore deities in spiritual tradition. But how did such a large number come into existence?

The idea is connected to the devotion of millions of people. In ancient times, many individuals formed their own personal connection with a guiding deity or master . Each person chose a divine form they trusted and surrendered to for guidance and protection.

Because millions of people created their own individual masters , the number of guiding energies became equal to the number of devotees. In simple words, if there were 33 crore people with their own chosen guiding deity or master , then naturally 33 crore divine guiding forces came into existence .
This is why the position of a deity or guru in someone’s life matters so much . The type of energy guiding you influences the direction of your life, your decisions, and even your spiritual progress.
Who Is the Master Really?
Understanding the true source of inner guidance.

In many cases, what we call intuition is actually the channel through which the master guides us. That inner voice telling you what feels right or wrong is often the subtle guidance working within you.
It may feel like your own instinct, but in reality a certain energy operates through your intuition and influences your decisions .
However, this energy is not necessarily God itself . If it were God, the person would know everything. Instead, it is a guiding force that knows certain things and directs you accordingly.
Choosing the Right Master

In India’s spiritual traditions, people often choose their master or spiritual path consciously . This is why some seekers visit spiritual centers — they are searching for a higher or more accurate source of guidance .

Many people come to places like Ashaeiynn because they feel their current guidance is not strong enough, and they want to connect with a master who can guide them more clearly and protect them better than before.
Why Are So Many Deities Found in India?

India has a unique spiritual culture where people often recognize extraordinary individuals as divine guides after their lifetime. In many regions, especially in places like Rajasthan, anyone who lived a life of courage, sacrifice, or protection for others is remembered and respected as a deity-like guardian .

Many of these figures were once ordinary humans who performed remarkable deeds. Over time, people began worshipping them because they believed their astral presence and protective energy still existed. For example, there are stories of protectors who sacrificed their lives while saving others or protecting animals. After their death, devotees started praying to them, believing that their spiritual energy continues to guard and guide people .

These beliefs grew stronger when devotees experienced certain forms of protection associated with these energies. Gradually, such figures became known as local deities or spiritual masters , and people started forming personal devotional connections with them
Why Having Multiple Masters Can Become Risky
Too many guiding forces can create confusion instead of protection.

When people began experiencing benefits from a single guiding deity, many thought that having multiple masters might bring even more protection and blessings . As a result, they started worshipping several deities at the same time.

However, Indian spiritual philosophy often explains human life in a different way. It suggests that every human body works like a vehicle guided by a higher force or master . In simple terms, a person with a physical body and life energy (pran tattva) is considered to be under the influence or guidance of a particular spiritual force.
Ancient teachings even describe this idea by saying that every person is connected to a guiding deity , meaning that some form of energy is directing the intuition and actions of that individual.

Because of this, having too many masters or guiding forces can sometimes create confusion in guidance. Just like in the physical world, when too many leaders try to give directions at the same time, the path becomes unclear.

In the larger spiritual system of masters and seekers , the real challenge is not to collect many masters but to choose the right guidance and follow it sincerely . In that sense, the path becomes clearer when a seeker learns how to remain a disciplined and devoted follower of the right master .
If guidance is waiting to arrive, are we ready to receive it?

In this world of masters and followers, the real task is to become a worthy and disciplined follower . In the Ashaeiynn path, the idea is simple: we are preparing ourselves so that when the right master or guiding energy appears , we are ready to receive that guidance.

To prepare for that, practitioners focus on cleansing their inner energy through the repetition of a particular mantra . The purpose of this practice is not just devotion, but purification—so that the energy within us becomes clear, stable, and receptive to higher guidance.

Here, pure energy does not mean something mystical or unreachable. It simply means that one dominant, harmonious energy governs the entire system of the body , rather than many conflicting energies pulling the person in different directions.
What Does “Pure Energy” Really Mean?

Our body is believed to contain many different energy centers, often described as 108 chakras , and each chakra carries its own type of energy and frequency. Because of this, a person naturally has multiple variations of energy operating within them .
A person is said to have “pure energy” when one consistent type of energy resonates through all these centers , creating harmony and alignment in the system.
But it is important to understand one thing: no one is truly impure . What people call impurity often depends on their own expectations.

For example, if someone is looking for a specific type of energy or quality in another person and it is not present, they may label that person as impure. In reality, the other person may simply have a different type of energy , not a lesser one.

So purity or impurity often depends on the perspective of the observer . When what someone expects is not found, they may call the other person impure—even though the person simply carries a different frequency of energy .
Why Do We Search for a Master?

Many seekers begin their spiritual journey with one simple purpose — to find the right master who can guide them correctly in life . The idea is not just devotion, but protection and direction. When a person feels that a reliable guiding force is present, life becomes lighter. There is a sense that someone is always there to warn, guide, and protect before any misfortune occurs .

A person who lives according to the guidance of the right master often experiences a kind of inner freedom. This is why people travel from place to place, searching for a guide they can truly rely on. When someone knows that a trustworthy master is guiding them, they can live without constant fear or confusion, because they believe they will receive intuitive signals before something negative happens .

A well-known example of this idea can be seen in the story of Krishna and Arjuna . Krishna did not fight the battle himself, but through his guidance Arjuna gained clarity and eventually victory. This illustrates what many seekers call the real power of a master — guidance rather than direct action .

Different people search for different types of masters. Some want guidance about the future, some seek physical strength, some wish to explore paranormal or mystical experiences, and others simply want spiritual wisdom. In many ways, the type of master a person finds often reflects what that person is truly seeking .

In Indian spiritual thought, it is believed that a guiding force remains connected to a seeker even beyond physical life. Because of this, people are encouraged to choose their guiding master carefully and remain grateful for that connection .
Note: In this context, the “master” is not necessarily a physical person, but often an astral or subtle guiding energy.
Why a Master Is Not a Physical Body

According to certain spiritual perspectives, a true master is not limited to a physical body . The idea is that once a being leaves the physical form and exists on a subtler level, they can guide many seekers simultaneously without the limitations of the physical world.
In this view, the master is understood as a guiding energy connected to the astral or subtle body of the seeker . This guiding presence influences intuition, warnings, and inner direction.

A person living in a physical body can certainly become a teacher, mentor, or friend who provides knowledge and support. However, within this belief system, they are not considered the ultimate master because they are still bound by physical limitations.
The master, therefore, is described as an unseen guiding force connected to the seeker’s astral body , quietly influencing intuition and direction from a subtler realm.
Why Does Everything Feel Like a Transaction?

In many spiritual teachings, intuition is seen as the inner guide or “master” within us . If someone wants to strengthen their intuition, they often believe they need to connect with a stronger or more evolved guiding force.
This is one reason why many people search for a master. They feel that by connecting with a powerful guide, their intuition and inner clarity can improve .

If you observe spiritual places carefully, you will often see many people serving or helping the head of that place. Sometimes it may appear as pure devotion, but in many cases people are also hoping to receive guidance, blessings, or a deeper connection to the divine through that person .

In that sense, many relationships in the spiritual world also involve a kind of exchange . Some people serve with expectations, while others may serve selflessly. Yet even those who expect nothing material may still hope for spiritual growth, protection, or connection to higher energies through that relationship.
Why the Right Master Matters

The guiding force connected to a person’s intuition influences the direction of their life . If the guiding energy is positive and balanced, it may help a person move toward clarity, growth, and stability.

However, if a person is influenced by negative or disturbing energies , the guidance they receive may also lead them toward confusion, emotional imbalance, or mental struggles such as anxiety or distress.

Because of this belief, many seekers visit different spiritual places or teachers in search of the right master or guiding force —someone who can help them realign their inner guidance and move toward a healthier and more positive direction in life.
The Role of Meditation and the Master

Meditation is a powerful practice because it strengthens the connection between a person and his master . When a person meditates continuously for many years, the bond between him and the energy guiding his intuition becomes extremely strong.

For example, if someone meditates regularly for 10–15 years, his connection with his master becomes very deep. Now the important point is this: if the master is the right one, meditation will give powerful and positive spiritual experiences. But if the master is a negative entity, then meditation will only strengthen that negative connection.

In that case, the person may start facing problems because the wrong master is guiding his intuition. When such a situation happens, sometimes another person who has the right master behind him can help replace that negative master. He does not do it alone—his own master helps him in replacing the other person’s master with the correct one.

So the experience of spiritual practices depends greatly on who the master is . If the master is right, the practice will give good experiences. If the master is not right, even sincere practice may lead to disturbing experiences.
A Real Case from Ashaeiynn
When meditation strengthened the wrong masters.
There was a couple connected with Ashaeiynn. The wife had stayed at a very famous spiritual place where she practiced continuous meditation for nine months .

During that period, her meditation became very deep. But the problem was that she had three masters connected to her intuition . Because meditation strengthens the connection with the master, her connection with those three masters became so strong that she started hearing their voices clearly . They used to talk to her continuously.
The issue was that those masters were negative entities . Because of this constant connection and voices, she became very disturbed and finally came to Ashaeiynn to get rid of them.
It took around three months for Bhaiya to replace those masters . After that process, her masters were replaced with the correct one and the disturbance stopped.
This shows that meditation increases the connection with the master , so the result of meditation depends on who the master actually is .
How a Master Can Attach to a Person

The master connected to a person can also come through the surroundings . For example, if a person frequently passes through a place like a cremation ground, a negative entity present there may get attracted to that person.
That entity may try again and again to connect with the person. If after repeated attempts the frequency matches , that entity can start sitting on the person’s intuition and become his master.
So the experience of meditation depends on the type of master connected to the person . Meditation itself only increases the connection—the real factor is which master is guiding the intuition .
Why Do Some People Suddenly Start Feeling Physical Illness or Pain?

Sometimes people suddenly start experiencing physical pain or illnesses that they never had before . This can happen when a person is being guided by a master whom the person himself would not like. Such a master is referred to as a negative energy .

Intuition has many deep levels. When a negative energy sits on a person’s intuition, it becomes that person’s master. If that person then begins meditating, the connection between the person and the master becomes stronger. Because of this stronger connection, the negative entity may try to enter the person’s body , which it is already using as its slave.

Once this negative entity enters the body, it starts trying to control the body . At that point, the body is no longer functioning completely as the person’s own body—the negative energy begins influencing it.

As a result, the illnesses or pains that the entity had when it was alive may start appearing in that person’s body. This happens because the master is now inside the person’s body, and the person begins to experience the body as if it belongs to that negative entity . Whatever physical problems that entity had before death can start manifesting in the person who is being controlled by it.
The Game of God

When a negative entity enters the body of a person, it eventually becomes trapped there. No matter what it tries, it cannot easily come out of that body. This is how the universe punishes negativity — by binding it inside the same body it tried to control .
Nature works according to certain principles. Just like the sun moves in a particular direction and the earth rotates according to cosmic laws , the universe also follows fixed spiritual laws.

One of these laws is that when a cosmic energy sits on the central nervous system , it begins to influence the body. When a negative master sits on the central nervous system of a person, it slowly acquires control of that body. But after some time, even if the master wants to leave the body, it cannot leave on its own. It becomes trapped inside.
When the Master Wants to Escape

After some years, the negative master may want to leave the body. But since it cannot separate itself directly, it starts looking for a person who can separate the master from the body it has acquired .

At this stage something very important happens. The master begins torturing the person so that the person starts searching for help. It can create problems like depression, anxiety, confusion, and constant failure , making the person feel that something is seriously wrong in life.

Because of this suffering, the person starts going to different spiritual places and healers , trying to find a solution. In reality, it is the master itself that is pushing the person toward these places, hoping that somewhere there will be someone who can separate it from the body .
The master makes the person feel like a failure again and again so that the person keeps searching for help.

This is why many people who later come to Ashaeiynn arrive there thinking they only want relief from their problems. But in reality, they have come to change their master , even though they may not realize it themselves.
The Real Meaning of a Master
The master is connected to the astral body, not the physical body.
Human civilization has always worked on the concept of masters. A human being cannot truly become the master of another human while staying in a physical body.
The master actually connects with the astral body . For someone to sit on the astral body of another person, that being must have already left the physical body .

This also explains why sometimes people see living individuals appearing in their dreams and guiding them . In reality, the physical person is not coming into the dream. It is the master connected to that living person’s astral body who appears and gives guidance.
When that happens, the same master can also become the master of the person who saw the dream .
Waiting for the Right Master
The path is to wait for the right master while purifying the body and mind. In Ashaeiynn, people chant mantras continuously so that their energy becomes pure.
Chanting works like a shield , protecting a person so that random entities cannot easily sit on their intuition and become their master.

In ancient times, many saints performed tapasya for thousands of years . During that long period, their masters kept changing again and again. They waited patiently until the best and highest master appeared .
This is the same principle followed in Ashaeiynn. People chant, purify themselves, and wait. During this time, many saints may come as temporary masters and later leave .
Eventually, the Guru Tattva of Ashaeiynn will come and become the master. The people of Ashaeiynn are being guided by Bhaiya , whose master is the Guru Tattva of Ashaeiynn.

When a person has multiple masters , confusion and misguidance happen. That is why a seeker must decide where to stop searching and whom to follow, while patiently waiting for the Guru Tattva to become the final master.
Final Thought
The entire journey is about purifying yourself and waiting for the right master . A person should chant, protect his energy, and stay patient.
When the right master comes, the guidance becomes clear, the confusion ends, and the path of life becomes stable.
That is why the real work of a seeker is not just searching for a master, but preparing himself so that the highest master can finally guide him .
So wait for your master by doing spiritual master once it comes then you get the real motive of your life and that shows to everyone they become a recognized person.
